title: Disputes Desk Computation Standard — Duplicate-Posting Final Credit on Northgate Card Accounts
content:
**1. The dispute settled.** On a **Northgate Card Credit Accounts (issued by Harbor Point Bank, N.A.)** account this rule settles one kind of dispute only: the most recent billing-error dispute on the account recorded with the reason duplicate, that is the one with the latest notice date and, of two received the same day, the one entered first in the account history, when that dispute still stands open, no resolution entry referring back to it, its source record is a Northgate order and the account's tier posts no provisional dispute credit; when that most recent duplicate dispute has been resolved or withdrawn, has another source, or the tier posts provisional dispute credits, this rule settles nothing and its amount is nothing.

**2. The investigation.** The investigation of that dispute compares the card purchase postings that carry the order's reference with what the Northgate order record charged, that is the order's amount paid plus the refunds its order history books against it as returns, price adjustments and other refunds: when two or more such postings carry the order's reference and together they exceed what the order charged, the investigation confirms the error at once, the dispute is resolved for the cardholder, its whole disputed amount leaves dispute status and the duplicate-posting final credit posts; in every other case this rule settles nothing and its amount is nothing.

**3. The duplicate excess.** The duplicate excess is the amount by which the purchase postings carrying the order's reference exceed what the order record charged, and never less than zero.

**4. The final credit.** The duplicate-posting final credit is the disputed amount recorded on the dispute. The amount posted adds together every amount this rule credits and takes away every amount it reinstates, each item already in whole cents, and the total is kept to the cent with no further rounding.

## Worked case (hypothetical figures)

| Record | Figure |
|---|---|
| Order record: amount paid | 84.00 |
| Order history: returns, price adjustments and other refunds | 0.00 |
| What the order charged | 84.00 |
| Card purchase postings carrying the order's reference | two postings of 84.00, together 168.00 |
| Disputed amount recorded on the dispute | 84.00 |

Two postings carry the order's reference and together exceed the 84.00 the order charged, so the error is confirmed; the duplicate excess is 84.00. The dispute is resolved for the cardholder, 84.00 leaves dispute status and the duplicate-posting final credit of 84.00 posts.

| Variation (hypothetical) | Outcome |
|---|---|
| only one posting carries the order's reference | nothing is settled under this rule |
| two postings carry it but together do not exceed what the order charged | nothing is settled under this rule |
| the most recent duplicate dispute already has a resolution entry | nothing is settled under this rule |
| the dispute's source is not a Northgate order | nothing is settled under this rule |
| the account's tier posts provisional dispute credits | nothing is settled under this rule |
| an order with 84.00 paid and a 20.00 return booked charged 104.00 | the postings are compared with 104.00 |
